verdict.rationale: Vanta markets seamless auditor collaboration in-platform. It documents an Auditor API that lets audit firms conduct audits inside Vanta: list the audits assigned to their firm, pull controls and evidence, manage information requests (IRLs), and review the resources and personnel in scope for each engagement. That implies scoped, engagement-level auditor access in place of emailed PDFs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the auditor-facing UI view and its permission scoping (evidence centers on the API), and independent or hands-on corroboration that auditors actually work this way in practice.
